evidence_class: local integration check against the live data feed (dry-run; nothing sent); pre-freeze, never evidence
setup: one-off process from the news-reversal worktree: --dry-run (no trading client), --no-scorer (no systemd unit touched), a separate state root, --rate 60, a scratch config with rth_reversal.from 2026-09-25, score rows read-only from the running service's scores.jsonl (--scores-from) for the events this run screened itself; the running service, its worktree and its state were not modified

code.note: runner and study code equal forward-protocol.json#/pins as drafted; the protocol text was edited after the run (wording, key names, analyze.py pin), so its sha256 here is an earlier draft's

counts.eligibility_note: guard B uses this process's own receipt time; it started at 09:43 ET, after every overnight event's 09:00 cutoff, so all overnight events were dropped (the service, running from 03:55, receives them in time)

intended_rth_reversal_entries.label: UNFAVORABLE
intended_rth_reversal_entries.note: shrunk to the net cap's headroom (0.10 E = 90,098.90 with the dry-run E of 900,988.95)

observation: Every directional liquid label in the run was UNFAVORABLE except one FAVORABLE (CRL, released 09:46 ET, entry 10:01, after the run ended), so every intended reversal entry was a long and the 0.10 E net cap stopped the long book after three names. Of the 21 candidates, 8 were decided, 1 (TT, entry 2 s before the stop) was still waiting for a quote stamped in its entry minute, and 12 had entries after the stop. The running service's own scores for 2026-09-25 (labels only, read-only) show the same skew: overnight liquid 12 FAVORABLE, 11 UNCLEAR, 100 UNFAVORABLE; RTH liquid to 09:55 1, 2, 16.
